node.text: If you are inclined to, there is one who would bear you company on your venture to Bethesda Susa should you ask them.

They are an oddity this one, a kind of their own.
A warrior nonetheless and a ventured one. They visit us from time-to-time seeking our artifacts in an attempt to understand themselves. A hurt and addled mind, but with good-intentions.
Their name is Ashiranandurah. As of now they are a face of the {{blue|Pariahs,}} earning their name as a dervish-hunter--they have slain Seeker thralls since their Second Youth.

Arshira relishes the captivation of adventure and exploring these treacherous lands, a drive only countered by the fear of their shadow. They get restless waiting for research results and watching tinkers' tinker. Need you someone to aid you in travel, look no farther.
The Stilt, they’ve been brooding lately, the poor thing practically crumbles in most social play. I believe you will need some standing to invoke Arshira’s services, but tis an option.
node.choice: I see, thank you, Iseppa. Live and drink.
